summary: Mako Mining filed a 6-K disclosing a non-binding LOI dated September 11, 2026 with non-arm's-length Sailfish Royalty for a corporate-level gold stream paying Sailfish 650-1,000 troy oz monthly over 240 months at 25% of the LBMA PM Fix. Consideration is 70,000,000 Sailfish shares at $5.76 (5-day VWAP), giving Mako roughly 49.00% of Sailfish. Sailfish intends a dividend policy of one gold ounce per 18,000 shares. Watch definitive documentation, related-party approval, and Mako's stated US$112 million cash return option.
